1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine __with a molecular weight__ of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker comprises a complexed zirconium compound.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine having a molecular weight of less than 2000 Da.

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex __nanoparticle__ has an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle __configured to entrap__ a multivalent cation.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al. 

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid. 

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or N,N-dimethylacrylamide. 

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where ___the___ fluid is brine or seawater.
